Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 106. Category: feat. Altered dnd 5e feats.

You have honed your proficiency with particular skills,
granting you the following benefits:
Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a
maximum of your current Ability Score Maximum.
You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.
Choose one skill in which you have proficiency. You
gain expertise with that skill, which means your
proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check
you make with it. The skill you choose must be one
that isn’t already benefiting from a feature, such as
Expertise, that doubles your proficiency bonus.
